faqs.question: Why is Upper Mustang special?
faqs.answer: Upper Mustang was a forbidden Tibetan Buddhist kingdom isolated from the outside world until 1992. It preserves authentic 15th-century Tibetan palaces, sky caves, and desert landscapes.
